_instructions: AZURE STORAGE ACCOUNT LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT POLICY FOR RoomToRentRadar
Azure rule filters at the Storage Account level REQUIRE every prefix to start with the container name: '<container-name>/<prefix>'.
In RoomToRentRadar, the configured KYC container defaults to 'kyc' (configured via KycStorage:ContainerName).
Therefore, the exact prefix matching staging blobs is: 'kyc/staging/'.
Verified KYC documents reside under 'kyc/verified/' and are NEVER matched or deleted by this rule.
If your deployment overrides KycStorage:ContainerName (e.g., 'radar-documents'), update this prefixMatch or use the accompanying Bicep/IaC template.
